Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. South Africa will look to seal the series in the next game itself, (Pink Day) 3rd ODI in Johannesburg, on February 4, 2017. Action begins 1330 local, 1130 GMT. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Man of the Match, FAF DU PLESSIS feels nice about tonight's innings as batting was challenging on what he describes a tough wicket to bat upon. Once the ball got old, it was not coming onto the bat and scoring boundaries became difficult. That was when ones and twos became important and pressure got built on the opposition. Praises Miller for changing the tempo of the innings and also agrees that the left-hand right-hand combination does irritate the bowlers.

South African skipper, AB DE VILLIERS starts off saying that it was a fantastic performance from the team. Calls the performance from Faf du Plessis and David Miller as outstanding. Accepts that the Sri Lankan openers did come hard at them but the class of their bowling showed through. Mentions that they took their chances and it worked in their favour as well and had talked about those before the game. On the wicket he says that the it played well and he never thought they would get to 300 so he credits the groundsman for it. Ends up saying it was a great team performance and calls it a 10/10 batting performance on a wicket which was two-paced. He rates it high with them being under pressure having lost four wickets early. Adds that he is looking forward to the Pink (3rd) ODI coming up and hopes his side can put up another good show for the crowd.

Sri Lankan skipper, UPUL THARANGA says that the Lankans were in the game when the Proteas were 100-odd for 4 but after that the home side got a good partnership and took the game away. Plays down that dropped chance of Faf du Plessis and says that such things happen. On the run chase, he blames the starts not being converted by his batsmen. Wants them to learn from David Miller and Faf du Plessis who resurrected the innings. On his health, he says he is fine, in spite of getting hit on the head twice.

The win makes it two games in a row that South Africa have completely outplayed the visitors in the ODIs. The only thing that worked in favour of them was the toss. Inserting South Africa in, they first conceded a big score courtesy of two centuries. Faf du Plessis and David Miller were both given a life and each made them pay scoring a ton. Sandakan bowled his heart out but will rue his teammates not backing him up. Sri Lanka need to really dig deep to find answers to take their cricket forward. Things are really not looking promising for them at the moment.

Dinesh Chandimal hung around for his 36 - the highest score for his side but South Africa kept chipping away at the wickets with all the bowlers contributing. Wayne Parnell, Imran Tahir, JP Duminy - all took a couple of wickets. Chris Morris, Andile Phehlukwayo and Kagiso Rabada chipped in with a wicket each. It was another comprehensive performance from them.

South Africa have annihilated Sri Lanka at Kingsmead, Durban. Sri Lanka have failed to cross 200 in two innings in the series so far. It is again a sorry scorecard for them with many of their players getting starts but none showing enough discipline to stay till the end to fight it out. Their openers got them off to a good start. But the visitors went from 45 for 0 to 75 for 4 in no time and it pegged them back a long way.

OUT! LBW! The decision stays as it is and SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 121 RUNS and take a 2-0 series lead! This always looked plumb. Landed around off, the slider, Sandakan went back to cut but missed and was hit on the pad. Tahir appealed and the umpire's finger went up in a flash. This time the batsman decided to take the review and Hawk Eye showed it to be crashing into the middle and leg stumps. Mild celebrations from Tahir tonight. He finishes with 2/26.
This time Sandakan wants to go one up on Tahir, he is given lbw and goes for the review. That looks dead plumb.

NOT OUT. Height factor. A nice googly, tossed up around off, Sandakan looked to defend coming forward but missed it. The ball missed the inside edge and hit the front pad and Tahir appealed for LBW. He appeared confident and wanted it reviewed and eventually de Villiers gave in. Hawk Eye showed the ball to be going over the top.
Sandakan is not given out lbw, Imran Tahir pleads to AB for a review and manages to convince him. Review time, it looks not out to the naked eye.
Short and outside off, Lakmal cuts it straight to David Miller at point who fumbles and concedes the single.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Lakmal misses his flick.
IMRAN TAHIR comes back on.
Very full and outside off, pushed towards point.
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
Lakshan Sandakan is the last man in.

OUT! Number 9 down! Full and straight, Kulasekara looks to flick but the ball curves in a touch and goes off the inner half of the bat. It is uppish and straight to Faf du Plessis at short mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball for a single.
A length ball around middle, angling down, Lakmal looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Rabada appeals for LBW but nothing in it.
Kagiso Rabada returns for a bowl. He has a slip in place along with a square leg.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler. Duminy has figures of 5-0-30-2 now.
Landed around off, defended back to the bowler.
Suranga Lakmal is the penultimate man in. Sri Lanka need 127 runs in 87 balls.

OUT! Gone this time. Floated outside off, Pathirana looks to play the slog sweep but is too far from the ball and gets a top edge. Wayne Parnell covers good ground to his right from deep mid-wicket and takes a simple catch.
Landed outside off, dabbed straight to short third man.
FOUR! Off the top edge now! Full and down the leg side, Pathirana gets down and across and looks to play the scoop. But the ball goes off the top edge and sails over short fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! BELLIGERENT! Floated outside off, Pathirana comes down the track and lofts it wide of long off for a boundary! Moves to 22 from 32 balls.
The batsman has driven it through mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Pathirana looks to play the slog sweep but misses.
The batsman plays the slog sweep. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, steered behind point for a couple.
Oohhh.... floated around off, Kulasekara initially looks to play the slog sweep, then tries to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up around middle, watchfully defended.
Goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Short and outside off, Pathirana backs away and punches it down to long off for a single.
Spins in from outside off, Nuwan looks to tuck but the ball goes off his pads towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
Shorter in length outside off, punched straight to cover.
FOUR! Up and over! Tossed up outside off, Kulasekara comes forward and lofts it over mid off for a boundary!
Outside off, played straight to point.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Dropped short on middle, Pathirana mistimes his pull to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for one.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a couple.
Short and outside off, punched down to long off for a single.
Full and down the leg side, SP looks to flick but misses the ball and is hit on the pads. De Kock appeals for LBW but neither the bowler nor the umpire seem interested.
Full and around off, flicked through square leg for a run.
Landed outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Short again, this time Pathirana takes some time to cut and gets it wide of cover for a single.
Short and outside off, slapped straight to cover.
Short and around off, punched down to long on for a single.
The googly now, shorter in length, comes in from outside off, Nuwan looks to tuck it away but misses and is hit on the pads. Tahir appeals for LBW but height is the issue.
Full and miles outside off, Kulasekara lunges to defend but is well inside the line.
This is flat and outside off, Sachith gets down and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Uppish... but safe. Tossed up outside off, Pathirana looks to go inside out but ends up skewing it. However, it goes safely over cover and the batsmen return for the second.
A full toss on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Imran Tahir comes back on for a bowl.

Bowls it outside off, Nuwan stays back to defend but gets an inside edge towards the on side. End of a successful over for the home side. Sri Lanka need 156 more in 120 balls but only have three wickets left.
NUWAN KULASEKARA walks in at number 9, replacing Chaturanga.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Floats it outside off, Chaturanga goes for the drive through covers but hits it in the air and Farhaan Behardien, the substitute takes a safe catch at short extra cover. The visitors sink further.
Nudges this one towards short fine leg for a single. There is a fumble but no harm done.
Stays put in his crease and defends it.
Shorter outside off, Pathirana chops it towards point. The bails went red but it was since the keeper who disturbed the stumps trying to collect the ball.
FOUR! In the gap! Shorter outside off, Pathirana stands his crease and cuts it through point for a boundary.
JP Duminy comes back on for a bowl.
FOUR! Edged again! Full outside off, Chaturanga gets an outside edge which runs through the gap between the keeper and Hashim Amla at first slip for a boundary to third man.
Dropped! A touch short outside off, Pathirana looks to guide it down to third man but the ball goes off the outside edge towards Amla at first slip. Amla dives to his left but only gets a hand to it.
On a length on the stumps, Pathirana tucks it towards square leg, where the fielder fumbles a touch but they do not get the single.
Full outside off, Pathirana looks to defend from his crease but is beaten all ends up.
Angled on the pads, turned through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Clattered! Short and wide outside off, Chaturanga smashes it behind point for a boundary. That was superbly done.
A touch short outside off, punched through point for a single.
A touch short outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single with an angled bat.
Another drive from Pathirana but it is gone to the fielder.
Full outside off, Pathirana drives it on the up towards covers.
Edged! On a good length on off, Pathirana gets an outside edge towards point from his crease.
Slants it full outside off, Pathirana drives it on the up towards mid off from his crease.
Outside off on a length, tapped into the off side but not for any run.
On a shorter length, Chaturanga pushes it towards point from his crease.
Expects a shorter one and waits on his back foot, gets the length ball and he guides it towards deep third man for a single.
WIDE! Bouncer! Shorter in length on the stumps, Pathirana ducks under it.
PEACH! Hurls it on a length just around off, Pathirana looks to defend from the crease but is beaten by the away movement at the end. Superb ball by Rabada!
A tad short outside off, Pathirana lets it go through.
Shorter outside off, Chaturanga guides it towards point for a single.
Too full outside off, Pathirana looks to squeeze it down but gets it off the inner half towards point. Sri Lanka need 176 more from 144 balls.
Sachith Pathirana is the new man in.

OUT! Easy as you like! Morris keeps it up and outside off on a fuller length, Chandimal comes across and looks to drive away from his body but gets an outside edge which flies through to the keeper who takes it going to his right. A soft dismissal but Chandimal has had many such dismissals in his career. He departs after another start.
On a length outside off, Chandimal looks to go hard at it but connect thin air.
Shorter outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single by de Silva.
Waits in his crease and guides it towards the off side.
On a length outside off, Chaturanga guides it towards point from his crease.
Chandimal pushes it towards the off side but not for any run.
WIDE! Bouncer! Shorter in length on the stumps, Chandimal ducks under it.
Guides it past point for a single with an angled face of the bat.
Dug in short but on the stumps, de Silva gets inside the line of it and ducks.
Chandimal pushes it towards point for a quick single.
Chandimal works it through square leg for a couple of runs.
A tad short outside off, tapped to the left of the fielder for a single by Chaturanga.
Too full on the stumps, Chandimal clips it through square leg for a brace as the fielder at backward square does not move an inch. The fielder at deep mid-wicket cuts it off.
FOUR! That was four the moment it hit the bat! Slightly over-pitched on the stumps, Chandimal gets across and clips it through wide mid on for a boundary.
An action replay of the previous delivery but this time Chandimal is loud and clear in his refusal of the run.
CHATURANGA DE SILVA walks in at number 7, replacing Gunaratne.

OUT! Gunaratne has to depart! Another fine piece of fielding does the trick! A tad short outside off, Chandimal taps it towards point and looks for a single. He decides against it late and sends Asela back. Duminy though is quick to the ball and fires a direct hit at the non-striker's end. It is referred upstairs and Gunaratne does not look confident enough. The replays tell us why though, he is short of the crease despite the dive. A vital stand broken.
RUN OUT APPEAL! It is a direct hit and Gunaratne has dived in, but is he safe? Referred upstairs...
FOUR! Angles it on the stumps, Chandimal gets across and swings it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length just around off, Chandimal stands tall and defends it.
Chris Morris too back on for a bowl.
Rabada attempts the yorker, dishes out a full toss as Chandimal walks down to it and turns it towards mid on for a single.
WIDE! This one though is sprayed down the leg side on a fuller length, Chandimal fails to clip and no doubts about this being a wide.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Chandimal walks across a touch at first but then lets it go. He is expecting a wide but it is not given.
Edged! A tad short outside off, Chandimal looks to ride the bounce. The ball gets a touch big on him but he does well to keep it down past first slip for a couple of runs.
A touch short outside off, Chandimal pushes forward to it and guides it towards point but fails to find the gap.
Tucks this one through square leg for a single.
Angles it on off, Chandimal works it through backward square leg for a single.
Time for another change, Kagiso Rabada comes back on.
A touch flatter on off, worked towards backward square for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Chandimal lunges forward and pushes it to covers.
Stays back and punches it through mid on for a single.
Chandimal comes forward and pushes it through covers for a single.
Fires it on the pads, turned through backward square leg for a single.
Floats it outside off, Gunaratne gets across the stumps and goes for the sweep. He gets a top edge that flies over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
JP Duminy brought on for a bowl.
Worked through mid on for a single by Gunaratne.
Chandimal gets behind this one and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Poor work! Chandimal gets across and sweeps it through backward square leg from outside off. Parnell gets across from square leg and dives but cannot stop the ball from going through for a boundary.
Shorter in length on off, Chandimal keeps it out towards the leg side.
Too full on the pads, clipped towards square leg for a single.
Floats it outside off, Gunaratne presses forward and pushes it towards covers.
Fuller on the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a brace.
WIDE! Shorter in length outside off, Chandimal lets it go through. The umpire signals it wide and also one bouncer for the over.
Angles it on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Dabbed down to point from the crease by Gunaratne but not for any run.
Gunaratne gets in line and defends it back down the wicket.
Fuller in length on off, Asela pushes it back down the wicket.
Angles it on the stumps, Gunaratne clips it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.

Imran bowls the googly around off, Chandimal does not pick it at all and is beaten. He is hit on his front leg. The bowler goes up for an lbw but the umpire stays put. They do not go for the review as it was a bit wide outside off and the replays confirm the same.

Gunarante guides this one with the turn towards short third man and scampers through for a single. There was a shy at the striker's end and de Kock took the bails off as  well but the batsman was always in.
Tossed up outside off, Asela takes it on the full but can only clip it to short mid-wicket.
Asela comes forward and taps it towards the on side. No risks being taken against Imran here.
Outside off, Asela watches it closely and pushes it towards cover-point.
Flatter on the stumps, Gunaratne defends it off the outer half of the bat.
A tad short outside off, Chandimal guides it towards point but cannot take the single as the fielder is too quick to it.

Half a shout! Shorter in length but on the leg stump. Chandimal looks to pull and it goes off something towards the keeper who takes the catch and appeals for a bit. Nothing much and the bowler walks back. Replays show the ball went off the elbow of the batsman.
Spears it on the pads, Chandimal clips it through mid-wicket. Rabada comes across from deep mid-wicket and mops up.
Fuller on off, Asela works across and turns it towards mid on from the crease.
Chandimal taps it towards point and takes the fielder on. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Duminy was the fielder there, had he hit, would have been close.
Guides it with an angled bat to third man for a single.
Floats it outside off, Chandimal comes forward but gets an outside edge towards backward point. End of a tight over by the leg spinner.
Too full on off, Chandimal brings his bat down in time to keep it out.
Loopy on off, Chandimal prods forward and defends it.
Too full on the stumps, pushed towards long on for a single.
Bowls the googly outside off, Gunaratne looks to defend but gets an inside edge. He has no idea where the ball went and looks around to keep it away from the stumps.
Floats it around off, Asela gets across and paddles it past short fine leg for a couple.
FOUR! Up and over! Shorter outside off, Chandimal spots the width and cracks it over the point fielder for a boundary. Spoils a good over for the home side.
Fuller outside off, Chandimal comes down the wicket to go over extra cover but fails to make contact with the ball.
Length ball outside off, keeps a touch low, Chandimal mistimes his chop towards the off side.
On a length on off, Chandimal gets squared up a touch and gets it towards point.
This time Chandimal dabs it towards short third man and looks for a single but is sent back.
Fuller on middle, Chandimal drives it back down the wicket.
Outside off and going away, Asela leaves it all alone.
Lands it on off, spins away a touch, Gunaratne defends it watchfully from his crease.
ASELA GUNARATNE walks in at number 6, replacing Dhananjaya.

OUT! Tahir, you beauty! Bowls the slider outside off, de Silva strides forward and plays inside the line of the ball and is beaten. The keeper takes the bails off and celebrates. Tahir joins him as well even despite watching the on-field umpire referring it upstairs. Replays confirm de Silva's back foot never came back in the crease and Tahir has a wicket early in his spell again. Sri Lanka in trouble!
STUMPING APPEAL! De Kock is confident that he has his man. Referred upstairs...
Dhananjaya de Silva comes forward and keeps this one out.
Shorter outside off, a touch quicker, de Silva defends it off his back foot.
Floats it on middle, turned towards mid on from the crease.
On a length on the pads, tucked through square leg for a single.
Dhananjaya de Silva walks in next.

OUT! Hit straight to the fielder! Outside off, Mendis looks to drive it on the up through covers. Faf takes a good low catch at short extra cover diving forward. Andile strikes in his first over! Kusal Mendis departs after a start once again. Sri Lanka's top order woes continue.
Stays back and Mendis defends it back down the wicket.
FOUR! Ticked away! On a length on the pads, Mendis gets across and works it to fine leg fence for a boundary.
Mendis drags this one towards mid-wicket. Chandimal wants the run but is sent back by Mendis. The throw comes in at the non-striker's end but again it is wide and this time Chandimal survives.
A touch short outside off, Chandimal taps it towards point and takes off for a single. Duminy gets to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses his shy at the stumps.
Andile Phehlukwayo introduced into the attack.
Floated up and Mendis gets out his broom and goes for a sweep but totally misses the ball as it goes straight to the keeper.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
Mendis stays in his crease and defends it off his back foot.
Chandimal has driven it through the mid off region for a single.
Tossed up, Chandimal just defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on the stumps, Mendis drives it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Imran Tahir comes on for a bowl.
Length ball and Chandimal drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Mendis guides this one towards thirdman for a single.
Again angling into the stumps, Mendis cuts it really late and fine towards the third man region. A brilliant dive by Morris saves the boundary and saves two runs in the process.
Mendis tries to poke it but is beaten.
FOUR! BEEAUTIFUL SHOT! Short delivery into the body, Mendis thinks of a cut but later just guides it down fine towards the thirdman region for a boundary. That was sensational improvisation there.
Low full toss outside off, Mendis plays it past point for a couple.
Chandimal drives it towards mid on from the crease.
A tad short outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Chandimal turns one through mid on for a single.
Pitched up outside off, Chandimal is right forward to defend that one.
The physio is out in the middle to attend Chandimal.

OUCH! Shorter in length around off, Chandimal looks to go for the big pull shot. The ball lobs up off the body and just falls away from the stumps. Chandimal looks to be in some pain here. Replays show the ball went off his right forearm. Must have been hurt, understandably too.
Fuller in length on off, Chandimal gets across and turns it towards the on side.
The umpire signals the start of the second Powerplay.
Mendis stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Again a fuller delivery and Mendis drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Again a superb drive but this time straight to the fielder at covers.
FOUR! Length delivery outside off, Mendis leans into it as he drives it through the cover region for a boundary. Exceptional shot.
Dinesh Chandimal walks in to bat.

OUT! SKIPPER DEPARTS! Fuller delivery and Upul goes to loft it straight down the ground over the mid off region. He gets it over but cannot find the distance as AB de Villiers who was standing at mid off goes tracing back and picks up a sensational catch. If Faf was the Superman, here comes the Batman.
Length delivery and Mendis has driven the last ball of the over straight to the fielder at covers.
Length delivery outside off, Mendis drives it elegantly but cannot find the gap as the ball goes straight to the fielder at covers.
On the pads, Tharanga clips it towards short fine leg for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.

FOUR! Short again to start with and Upul is back to business. He has pulled that one through the square leg region for another boundary.
Short delivery outside off, Tharanga goes for a upper cut but does not time it well as it just falls short of the fielder at thirdman and the skipper retains his strike.
Mendis gets an outside edge through the slip region for a single to get off the mark.

OUT! SUPERMAN FAF! Length delivery outside off, Dickwella tries to go over the extra cover region but he gets it off bottom half of the bat. The ball is in air and seems destined to clear the infield. But du Plessis from covers, goes to his left first and then sticks out his right hand in the air. And just like that he manages to hold onto it. One of the best catches you will see. Dickwella will be disappointed as he was looking settled in the middle.
Short into the body, Tharanga goes for a pull and manages a single.
Fuller on the off, Dickwella drives at wide of the fielder at mid off to get a single.
David Miller is walking off the field. Farhaan Behardien is back on the field.

Full toss on the pads, Dickwella just flicks it off his pads and the ball flies away towards square leg. The ball just falls short of Miller who dives forward to reach at it. They manage to get a couple. Miller has hurt his finger in the process as we can say see he is bleeding heavily.
Shorter outside off, Dickwella rams it down to third man for a single.

FOUR! Jayasuriya would be feeling happy about this! He is the selector of the team and the players are playing just like he did all his career. Coming to the ball, it was a fuller one on the stumps, Dickwella just got under it, worked it with his wrists over mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence.
Slower and fuller on off, Dickwella is early into his shot and pushes it towards covers.
Tharanga drags this length ball through mid-wicket for a single.
Tharanga is getting some medical treatment and also has called for a change of helmet.

On the body, Tharanga defends it on the on side.

Length ball outside off, Tharanga defends it on the off side.

Swinging away after pitching, Tharanga stays in his crease and tries to slash at it but is beaten by the away movement.
Fuller on the stumps, Niroshan gets the Dilscoop out as he manages to get it over the keeper for a single towards fine leg.

FOUR! SHORT AND PULLED! Another short ball and Tharanga just knows what to do with it as he pulls it through the square leg region for another boundary. The chase is on for the Lankans.
Dug in short, Tharanga ducks under it.

On the pads, Tharanga flicks it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length ball and Tharanga drives it straight to the fielder at mid on.

Back of a length delivery angling into the body, Tharanga clips it towards square leg. No run taken.
Yorker this time which nearly did the skipper. Upul just somehow managed to keep it at bay.
On the pads, Dickwella flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, Dickwella stays deep in his crease and plays it behind point for a single.
Fuller on the pads, Upul clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
NASTY! Dug in short and  that has taken the skipper by surprise. He tries to get out of the way but gets hit on the flap of the helmet.
Back of a length delivery on the body, Upul camps back and defends it well.
Upul stays in his crease and defends it off his back foot.
FOUR! Short delivery outside off, Tharanga slashes at it through the point region for a boundary. What a way to get off the mark for the skipper.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
FOUR! On the pads again, the batsman has flicked it beautifully through the square leg region for a boundary. That just reminded me of Sanath Jayasuriya.
FOUR! On the pads, Niroshan gets his front leg out of the way as he flicks it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Good length delivery which swings after pitching, Dickwella tries to defend it but he is beaten by the away swing as the ball goes straight to the keeper.

Outside off, Dickwella slashes hard at it through the point region and they get a couple.

The umpire goes upstairs to check if Dickwella has managed to get back in time. Replays show that if de Kock was a bit quicker there then Dickwella would have been walking back. A run out is appeal has been referred upstairs.

Good length delivery to start with, Dickwella cuts it hard but straight to the fielder at point.
Welcome back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Niroshan Dickwella and Upul Tharanga will open the innings for Sri Lanka. Kagiso Rabada will start the proceedings for South Africa.
